focal_axis.note: Altar currently at the NW corner (r ~19.9 m); whether a central structure replaces/adds to it is Nishant's decision - this list does not assume it.

camera_note: Gameplay camera sits toward +x,-z of the player and looks toward -x,+z, so the altar axis runs UP the screen. Tall pieces are kept off the +x/-z side; heights measured from the kit meshes: Brazier_A 1.34 m, ColumnDrum_A 1.10 m, Rubble_A 0.44 m, Rubble_B 0.30 m; only the wall-mounted Banner_A (2.52 m) is taller.
parts_used: existing kit parts only (Brazier_A, Banner_A, ColumnDrum_A, Rubble_A, Rubble_B); no new meshes

placements.label: approach brazier L
placements.reason: Lit pair 3 m before the stairs frames the approach to the altar and pulls the eye along the axis. Warm light only, stays outside the clear circle.

placements.label: approach brazier R
placements.reason: Pair partner (5.6 m gap). Symmetry here is deliberate: it is the formal entrance to the focal zone; everything else stays asymmetric.

placements.label: banner W wall by dais
placements.reason: Crimson (the only crimson in the kit) concentrated at the focal corner = colour hierarchy. Wall-mounted: no collision, no combat footprint.

placements.label: banner N wall by dais
placements.reason: Second banner flanks the dais from the other wall; same yaw convention as the existing wall banners.

placements.label: fallen drum, flank
placements.reason: Low ruin silhouette on the flank; its diagonal leads toward the altar without blocking the sight line (1.1 m tall, measured).

placements.label: rubble, approach flank
placements.reason: Breaks the clean floor beside the approach; low and small, no collision problem.

placements.label: rubble, far flank
placements.reason: Pushes debris toward the wall edge, away from the combat circle and the approach lane.

placements.label: rubble, east corner
placements.reason: Weights the far (screen-top) corner so the frame is not empty away from the altar; outside any lane.
